messages:
maya (Marketing): Quick pass needed on launch post draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/launch-v3. Three asks: audience hook (PM vs infra), benchmark wording, and webinar sign-up flow. Can people flag ASAP? :wave:

trent (Product): Skimming. My rec: 1-line PM opener, then an infra highlight box with numbers. Two CTA paths makes sense.

lee (Growth): Single HubSpot form with hidden field for segment is best. Use ?seg=pm or ?seg=infra to set hidden value. I'll add workflow IDs once copy is locked.

zoe (Design): I'll create two hero variants and a compact features->buyer table. ETA 4h.

ana (Legal): Heads up: avoid absolutes. Use "up to" and link to benchmark methodology. Add a one-line disclaimer under numeric claims.

maya (Marketing): Trent 1 can you draft the PM TL;DR (2 lines) and a safe benchmark sentence? Lee, paste the HubSpot snippet.

trent (Product): PM TL;DR: "Move faster with LLM features 1 Redwood abstracts serving so product teams ship prompts, routing, and monitoring in days, not months." Benchmark (safe): "In internal tests, Redwood reduced per-token latency by up to 25% vs standard A100 baseline and lowered per-request GPU cost by up to 30% (internal benchmark, June 2026; methodology linked)."

ana (Legal): That's acceptable provided you link the benchmark doc and include the methodology (models, seq len, batch). Also add: "Results may vary by workload and deployment."

lee (Growth): HubSpot snippet: `<form action=\"https://forms.hubspot.com/submit/abc123\"><input type=\"hidden\" name=\"lead_source\" value=\"launch_blog_2026\"><input type=\"hidden\" name=\"seg\" value=\"__SEG__\"><input name=\"email\" type=\"email\"/><button>Register</button></form>` Replace __SEG__ via URL param. Workflows: wf_311_pm and wf_311_infra. Tag: launch_26_cohortA.

zoe (Design): Webinar seats = 300. lee, can reg-bot flip CTA to "Join waitlist" at 280? I'll style the waitlist CTA orange.

reg-bot: Registration thresholds set: notify_at=250, waitlist_threshold=280, capacity=300. Will post counts to #marketing.

maya (Marketing): Great. I'll add the benchmark link + disclaimer, fold hero variants and the table, then re-upload by EOD. If no blockers we hand to comms for copy lock tomorrow. :rocket:
